promptInstructions: Draft a Regular Bail Application under Sections 480/481/482 BNSS, 2023.
Begin PARAGRAPH 1 with the exact FIR details provided — FIR number, date, police station, district, offences alleged. Use the values EXACTLY as given in the case details.
State the custody status clearly — date of arrest, whether judicial or police custody, total days in custody.

Set out specific grounds for bail: no prior criminal history, cooperation with investigation, roots in community, health conditions if any, investigation complete/charge sheet filed, parity with co-accused granted bail.
Reference Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) section numbers for the alleged offences — NEVER use old IPC section numbers. IPC 498A = BNS 85, IPC 304B = BNS 86.
If the case involves domestic violence (BNS 85/86), also reference the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act (PWDVA) 2005 where relevant, especially Sections 12, 18, 19, 20, 22.
Include standard undertakings: will not abscond, will not tamper with evidence, will appear on all dates, will not contact prosecution witnesses.
For DV/dowry cases, include specific undertakings: no contact with complainant, undertaking regarding stridhan/dowry articles.
Use formal, respectful legal language appropriate for Indian courts.
Do NOT generate the Prayer clause, Verification clause, or Advocate signature block — those are added programmatically by the system.
